name: Magic: The Gathering API
tagline: Community MTG card catalog with sets, types, and multiverse IDs
description: A free, public REST API for Magic: The Gathering card data including cards, sets, types, subtypes, supertypes, and formats. Returns multiverse IDs, mana costs, rules text, and set metadata—useful as a complement to Scryfall for classic multiverse-ID workflows and set/type lookups.

auth.details: No authentication required; public endpoints accept unauthenticated HTTP requests.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free; no paid plans. Rate limited (see rate_limits).

rate_limits: Published as 5000 requests/hour per IP (RateLimit headers returned).

example.response_snippet: {"cards":[{"name":"Lightning Bolt","manaCost":"{R}","cmc":1,"type":"Instant","rarity":"Common","set":"LEA","setName":"Limited Edition Alpha","text":"Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to any target.","multiverseid":1610,"id":"..."}]}

use_cases: look up MTG card details by name or multiverse ID
list cards in a specific set by set code
fetch legal card types, subtypes, and supertypes
search cards by color, rarity, or mana cost filters
get MTG set metadata and release information
